roleTitle: Registered Nurse Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS, as an Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON). This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and support our nursing team, ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence and operational efficiency.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing daily nursing operations, staff development, and quality assurance. We offer a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year for this full-time position, reflecting your expertise and commitment to our mission. Join a supportive environment where your leadership skills will be valued and contribute directly to the well-being of our residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Kansas
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Prior leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare environment
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience within the range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year.
